name: edit_file
description: Change part of an existing text file: replace old_text with new_text. Read the file first and pass its version. old_text must match the file exactly (including spaces) and appear exactly once; add surrounding lines to make it unique, or set replace_all to change every occurrence.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace folder

old_text.description: The exact text to replace, copied from read_file

new_text.description: The text to put in its place

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of exactly one. Default false
